svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: ADS9324: Typical application
svg.desc: Schematic of the ADS9324 typical application: the chip with U2 MCU, C1 capacitor 1 µF, C2 capacitor 0.1 µF, C3 capacitor 1 µF, C4 capacitor 0.1 µF, C5 capacitor 1 µF, C6 capacitor 0.1 µF, C7 capacitor 4.7 µF, C8 capacitor 1 µF, C9 capacitor 1 µF, R1 resistor 1 kΩ, R2 resistor 1 kΩ, C10 capacitor 10 nF; the MCU wires carry the port hooks GpioGet(CtrlPin::DrdyAlarm), GpioSet(CtrlPin::Convst), GpioSet(CtrlPin::Reset), Transfer().
svg.text: One channel of the ADS9324 with the internal reference (REFSEL high), the data on SDOUT (1 lane) and the three supplies decoupled as Figure 9-4 shows; CONVST, RESET and
DRDY/ALARM are on GPIOs the driver uses through GpioSet() and GpioGet(). The other fifteen channels repeat the input filter. Above each MCU wire: the port hook that drives it.

* Not confirmed in the datasheet: R1 1 kΩ: REXT: the data sheet gives no value; choose it for the source and the input filter; R2 1 kΩ: REXT: matched to R1 so the positive and negative paths see equal source resistance; C10 10
nF: CEXT: the data sheet gives no value; it sets the filter corner with REXT; net +3V3: example IOVDD; the data sheet allows 1.7 V to 3.6 V. REFSEL high selects the internal reference.
